subject: iOS -ffreestanding syntax gate broken by untracked metal/tegu/ycbcr_decode.h (#include <string.h>)
body: clang --target=arm64-apple-ios16.0 -ffreestanding ... -fsyntax-only metal/tegu/compute_frontend.m now fails: render_encoder.inc:930 -> ycbcr_decode.h:23 #include <string.h> pulls host glibc headers (gnu/stubs-32.h not found).
